gaps.explanation: Two parts. (1) Missing fund columns: p4 Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds prints Debt Service and Capital Projects columns with no schedule. Debt Service: Taxes - property 4,079,650 + Taxes - city sales 14,937 + Development contribution 452,877 + Highway allocation funds 216,821 + Investment and interest income 249,184 = 5,013,469 (printed Total revenues). Capital Projects: Taxes - property 3,948,521 + Taxes - city sales 505,267 + Taxes - city sales additional 1/2% 4,560,439 + Licenses, permits and fees 1,582,752 + City of LaVista - fire agreement 50,000 + Federal grants 151,465 + State Grants 10,102 + Other intergovernmental 283,169 + Highway allocation funds 319,337 + Investment and interest income 2,706,323 = 14,117,375 (printed). 38,826,628 + 5,013,469 + 14,117,375 = 57,957,472. (2) Different basis, no fix: the pp8-12 schedules are 'Budget and Actual - Budgetary Basis': General p8 Total revenues 34,842,738 vs p4 General 45,944,708 (-11,101,970; e.g. Taxes - city sales 2,105,515 vs 13,161,114); ARPA p9 195,541 = p4; Keno Lottery p10 919,818 vs p4 922,763 (-2,945); Papillion Landing p11 2,493,696 vs p4 2,488,637 (+5,059); Papio Bay p12 374,835 = p4. -11,101,970 - 2,945 + 5,059 = -11,099,856; 57,957,472 + 11,099,856 = 69,057,328 = statement total. After the fix the schedule is 11,099,856 short, all budgetary-basis difference.
